subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar adopt `codexbar guard` and its quota-window, fail-open, JSON, and exit-code contract as a supported automation interface once the correctness gaps are fixed?
rationale: The branch adds a new user-facing command and several durable scripting semantics; source correctness can be repaired mechanically, but only repository ownership can decide whether this automation contract belongs in the product.

options.title: Approve after repair
options.body: Accept the command direction after it shares account/window normalization with `usage`, adds regression coverage, and includes convincing real-provider proof.

options.title: Defer the command surface
options.body: Keep the paired proposal open for design discussion and close or pause this implementation until the CLI contract is explicitly sponsored.
